title: A GN issued again after GB restarts the walk at the first root
shapes: HKEP HKEPWALK 2000-RESTART: the same unqualified GN, issued after the loop ended on GB
asserts: HKEPWALK's 2000-RESTART CALL is a second dli_calls fact with the same function, pcb and io_area as H-0097's: the same call text twice, two facts.

citations.quote: If you issued the GN again after the GB status code, IMS would return the first segment occurrence in the database.
